_source: SIA 265:2021, Tabelle 25 (clause 6.2.1.4) -- transcribed by hand from the German edition, ExternalFiles/000-Normes/SIA265-2021-DE.pdf p. 66.
_note: K_ser = c · rho_k^0.5 · d^1.7 per dowel and shear plane, in N/mm with d in mm and rho_k in kg/m3. Only the coefficient c is tabulated; the two exponents belong to the formula and are written beside it. The values hold for Feuchteklasse 1 and short-term loading -- another moisture class multiplies them by eta_w for stiffness (Tabelle 4), which is a separate table.

table_25.title: Verschiebungsmodul K_ser pro Stabdübel und Scherfuge für Feuchteklasse 1
table_25.note: Für beliebige Winkel zwischen Kraft- und Faserrichtungen darf linear interpoliert werden.
